title: Tamsin and the Witness
author: Oscar Eastwick
blurb: Lior Brightwater, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
